description: Harder search queries, written on 2026-11-23 before any of them was run, to test the retriever and the rewrite loop where the ordinary queries cannot. `vague`: a symptom, with none of the documentation's words. `other_cloud`: the vocabulary of AWS. `two_topics`: one query that mixes two subjects. `uncovered`: a question on a supported service that no document in the store answers; the right outcome is that nothing is kept. A query counts as answered when any of its `expected_docs` is found.
